messages.subject: Project Forge — signed board minute authorising the undertakings
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Following today's board meeting, please find attached the signed minute. The board has resolved to offer the undertakings in lieu and has authorised Grace to negotiate, finalise and sign them. The board also reaffirmed the commitment to comply with the IEO pending completion of the divestment.

Kind regards
Naomi Patel
Company Secretary | Pennington Industries Limited

messages.snippet: Dear Ms Cho, Please find attached the undertakings in lieu of reference, executed by Grace Underwood
messages.subject: ME/7104/25 — executed undertakings in lieu
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Cho,

Please find attached the undertakings in lieu of reference, executed by Grace Underwood for and on behalf of Pennington Industries Limited, reflecting the agreed terms (four-month initial divestiture period, ten-working-day Monitoring Trustee proposal deadline and the up-front buyer provision). We look forward to the CMA's formal acceptance and to working with the case team on the purchaser approval process.

Regards
James Osei
